description: Hessa/von Heijne DG(app) membrane-insertion prediction for AADAC family versus experimental type II signal anchors and cleaved signal peptides
code:
import requests, re, time, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
s=requests.Session(); s.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Referer":"https://dgpred.cbr.su.se/index.php?p=fullscan"})
accs={"AADACL2":"Q6P093","AADAC":"P22760","NCEH1":"Q6PIU2","AADACL3":"Q5VUY0","AADACL4":"Q5VUY2",
      "DPP4 (type II, exp)":"P27487","ST6GAL1 (type II, exp)":"P15907","ASGR1 (type II, exp)":"P07306",
      "CD74 (type II, exp)":"P04233","SEC61B (tail-anch. ctrl)":"P60468",
      "CES1 (ER-lumen, cleaved SP)":"P23141","ALB (secreted, cleaved SP)":"P02768",
      "LIPC (secreted, cleaved SP)":"P11150","LIPG (secreted, cleaved SP)":"Q9Y5X9",
      "PON1 (uncleaved SP, HDL)":"P27169","INS (secreted, cleaved SP)":"P01308"}
seq={k:requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","") for k,a in accs.items()}

def dgscan(name,sq,lmin=19,lmax=23,win=55):
    r=s.post("https://dgpred.cbr.su.se/results.php?program=fullscan",
             data={"seq":f">{name}\n{sq[:win]}\n","Lmin":str(lmin),"Lmax":str(lmax),"with_length":"on"},timeout=120)
    t=re.sub(r"<[^>]+>"," ",r.text); t=t.replace(" "," ")
    hits=re.findall(r"(\d+)\s*-\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(-?\d+\.\d+)\s+([A-Z]{15,30})",t)
    return hits

rows=[]
for k,sq in seq.items():
    h=dgscan(k,sq); time.sleep(0.4)
    if h:
        st,en,L,dg,hs=min(h,key=lambda x:float(x[3]))
        rows.append(dict(protein=k,start=int(st),end=int(en),length=int(L),dG_app=float(dg),segment=hs))
    else:
        rows.append(dict(protein=k,start=np.nan,end=np.nan,length=np.nan,dG_app=np.nan,segment="no helix predicted"))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows)
D["class"]=["AADAC family"]*5+["type II signal anchor (experimental)"]*4+["tail anchor ctrl"]+["cleaved signal peptide"]*4+["uncleaved SP (PON1)"]+["cleaved signal peptide"]
print("Hessa/von Heijne DG(app) for Sec61-mediated membrane insertion (dgpred.cbr.su.se, windows 19-23 aa, residues 1-55)")
print("Negative dG(app) = insertion into the ER membrane is thermodynamically favourable\n")
print(D[["protein","class","start","end","length","dG_app","segment"]].to_string(index=False))
D.to_csv("dGapp_membrane_insertion.csv",index=False)
print("\nmedian dG by class:")
print(D.groupby("class").dG_app.agg(["count","median","min","max"]).to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.6))
colmap={"AADAC family":"#d1495b","type II signal anchor (experimental)":"#8d6a9f",
        "cleaved signal peptide":"#3a7ca5","uncleaved SP (PON1)":"#e3a008","tail anchor ctrl":"#777"}
d=D.dropna(subset=["dG_app"]).sort_values("dG_app")
ax.barh(d.protein,d.dG_app,color=[colmap[c] for c in d["class"]])
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=1.2)
ax.text(-0.05,-0.8,"inserts as TM helix  <-",ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.05,-0.8,"->  does not insert",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("predicted $\\Delta G_{app}$ of Sec61 membrane insertion (kcal/mol)")
ax.set_title("AADACL2's N-terminal segment inserts into the ER membrane on the\nbiological hydrophobicity scale, unlike cleaved signal peptides",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
